clue.text: Element man left out sometimes hard in winter

definitions.text: Element man left out sometimes hard in winter

parts.words: Element man left out sometimes hard in winter
parts.note: one of the four classical elements: a bucket of it that someone leaves outside overnight in a cold season freezes solid

explanation.surface: A puzzling remark about an element that a man left outside goes hard in winter.
explanation.definitionFit: Water is one of the four classical elements, and left outdoors in frost it turns to ice.

clue.text: Measurement that goes up and down in women's fashions

definitions.text: Measurement that goes up and down in women's fashions

parts.words: Measurement that goes up and down in women's fashions
parts.note: a girth measure whose position on dresses rises and falls with changing styles, and which also grows and shrinks on the wearer

explanation.surface: A tape measure reading that fluctuates with the trends of ladies' clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: The waist measurement, and the height of a dress's waist seam, both shift with style and diet.

clue.text: Dangerous situation to be in when drunk?

definitions.meaning: a jam or predicament that is hard to get out of
tight is slang for tipsy, so a place for the inebriated, said playfully

explanation.definitionFit: A tight spot is an idiom for a difficult or risky predicament.

clue.text: Speed estimate

definitions.meaning: to assess or value, as in to ... someone highly

explanation.definitionFit: Rate means pace of movement and also, as a verb, to judge the worth of something.

clue.text: Shipmates rioting on board this?

indicators.note: a riot is disorderly chaos, so these letters run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: Sailors causing a mutiny aboard their vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam-powered vessel is just the kind of ship whose crew could riot on board.

clue.text: Reliable fence for radio equipment?

parts.note: sound means dependable, as in sound advice
a fence is a criminal who handles stolen goods, also called a receiver

explanation.surface: A trustworthy dealer in stolen goods, seen as a piece of wireless kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fence' looks like garden boundary but is slang for a buyer of stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A device that picks up audio broadcasts is a receiver of sound, so radio gear in the whimsical sense.

clue.text: African wasteland

definitions.meaning: a North African Muslim of Berber or Arab descent

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a North African people and a stretch of bleak heath.

clue.text: How heats are contested

parts.note: qualifying races are fought out fiercely, with a play on heat meaning warmth

explanation.surface: A sports commentator on the way preliminary rounds are fought.
explanation.definitionFit: Hotly means fiercely or keenly, and heats are by name hot things.

clue.text: Priest had to shave round back of head

indicators.note: the shaving word goes round the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: to pare is to trim or shave off a thin layer

indicators.note: the back of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A clergyman obliged to shave the back of someone's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Had to' is a link. D, the last letter of 'head', sits inside PARE after its A.
explanation.definitionFit: A padre is a chaplain, especially a military one.

clue.text: Cast entered the wrong way round

indicators.note: the two halves of the phrase swap places, so its front part moves to the back

parts.note: to have got in is to have entered

explanation.surface: An actor's cast who came in backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: GOT IN with its two words swapped gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingot is a block of metal cast in a mould.

clue.text: Pure but has not been seen

definitions.meaning: without a spot or blemish, unstained
not spotted, that is not noticed

explanation.definitionFit: Unspotted means both stainless and unobserved.

clue.text: Patient gets carried away

parts.note: not someone overexcited but an injured person borne off on a litter

explanation.surface: A hospital patient becoming overexcited.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone too hurt to walk is borne off on a litter by medics.

clue.text: Carry endless pole

indicators.note: the word loses its final letter, so it has no end

parts.note: a totem is a carved pole of a North American people

explanation.surface: An instruction to lug a pole with no end.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote is to carry, usually something heavy.

clue.text: What worshippers are about to do

definitions.text: What worshippers are about to do

indicators.note: the word are goes about, enclosing, the word do

explanation.surface: Asking what congregants are on the point of doing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About to do' reads as an intention, but 'about' is the container signal and the whole clue doubles as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Worshippers revere and love their god, the very thing the word means.

clue.text: Northerner initially takes wrong key

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word takes
the word key is put wrong, its letters muddled

explanation.surface: A man from the north picks up the wrong key.
explanation.definitionFit: Tyke is a nickname for a Yorkshireman, from northern England.

clue.text: A girl redesigned the platter

indicators.note: something redesigned is reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A young woman gave the serving dish a new design.
explanation.definitionFit: The Holy Grail of legend was a dish or cup used at the Last Supper.

clue.text: Dish served to surly fellow on the railway

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog, so a mean-spirited man

explanation.surface: A meal handed to a grumpy man on a train.
explanation.definitionFit: A curry is a spiced dish of Indian origin.

clue.text: Figure that cannot be improved on

definitions.text: Figure that cannot be improved on

parts.words: Figure that cannot be improved on
parts.note: a flawless digit, but in mathematics a value equal to the sum of its divisors, such as six

explanation.surface: Praise for a body shape or score that is unbeatable.
explanation.definitionFit: In maths, 6 and 28 are called perfect because their divisors add up to them.

clue.text: The warder is no vegetarian apparently

definitions.text: The warder is no vegetarian apparently

parts.words: The warder is no vegetarian apparently
parts.note: a Tower of London guard whose nickname reads as someone who consumes cattle meat

explanation.surface: Gossip that a prison guard is a meat lover.
explanation.walkthrough: The Yeomen Warders of the Tower of London are popularly known by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Yeoman Warders at the Tower carry the nickname, which literally says they consume beef.

clue.text: Not wearing smooth footwear?

parts.note: a horse with nail heads left proud on its shoes for grip, the idiom meaning ruthlessly

explanation.surface: A remark about someone whose shoes lack slick soles.
explanation.walkthrough: To ride roughshod is to act without regard for others; literally, a horse whose shoes have projecting nails.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughshod literally describes horseshoes with nail heads sticking out to stop slipping.

clue.text: Stuff in a stable?

parts.note: stuff as a verb, to gorge oneself, done the way a stall animal does

explanation.surface: Asking what kind of material is kept in a barn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stuff' looks like a noun for hay or tack; it is the verb, to gorge.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to have an enormous appetite, like a horse in its stall.

clue.text: Put up with a little sugar

definitions.meaning: a cube of sugar for tea

explanation.definitionFit: Lump means to endure grudgingly, as in like it or lump it, and a sugar cube.

clue.text: It is allowable, having landed to go round the islands

indicators.note: the landing word goes round, encircling, the islands abbreviation

parts.note: lit is a past tense of alight, so landed or settled
CI stands for the Channel Islands

explanation.surface: Permission granted to circle the islands after touching down.
explanation.walkthrough: The Channel Islands lie between England and France.
explanation.definitionFit: Licit means lawful or permitted.

clue.text: The reported style of a country house

indicators.note: reported means spoken out, so the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: a manner is a way or style of doing things

explanation.surface: Gossip about the decor of a stately home.
explanation.definitionFit: A manor is a landed estate with its main residence.

clue.text: Frank's on time

parts.note: over can mean on or upon

explanation.surface: Frank is punctual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank's' reads as a name with a possessive but is 'Frank is', the definition plus a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and not hidden, as frank speech is.

clue.text: She followed Eliza to the throne

definitions.text: She followed Eliza to the throne

parts.words: She followed Eliza to the throne
parts.note: not a successor queen: a short female name that, placed after Eliza, spells a monarch's full name

explanation.surface: A historical note on royal succession after a queen.
explanation.walkthrough: Put this name after ELIZA and you get the full name of Queen Elizabeth.
explanation.definitionFit: Beth is a short form of a woman's name, and Eliza plus it makes the queen's name.

clue.text: One who loved to be in the rose-garden?

indicators.note: the letters are found to be in the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A lover pictured among the roses.
explanation.definitionFit: Eros is the Greek god of love.

clue.text: Expression of dissatisfaction of speed after a bend

indicators.note: the speed piece comes after the bend piece

parts.note: a U-bend, so U stands for a bend
MPH, miles per hour, is a measure of speed

explanation.surface: A grumble about going fast after a curve.
explanation.definitionFit: A grunting interjection voicing displeasure.

clue.text: What could be nicer, song about a brightly-coloured flower?

indicators.note: what the word nicer could be means its letters may form something else

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in opera

explanation.surface: Asking what could be lovelier than a song about a vivid bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could be' turns NICER into CINER; 'about' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Cineraria is a daisy-like pot plant with vivid blooms.

clue.text: Striker to make light of

parts.note: not a footballer nor trivialising: something struck to produce a flame

explanation.surface: A footballer to be scoffed at.
explanation.definitionFit: A matchstick is struck to give fire and light.

clue.text: Bird changes colour

parts.note: turns means changes, as leaves turn
a tone is a shade of colour

explanation.surface: A bird altering its hue.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnstone is a wading shorebird.

clue.text: He got the measure of an old king

parts.note: a rod is an old unit of length

explanation.surface: He measured up an ancient monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Herod the Great was king of Judea in biblical times.
